header.purpose: Full enumeration and dependency-closure audit of all tracked files in AED at b57fcaad806c68b93668bcd318fa26ab15a8ab40 against AutoDev PR #1's extracted supervisor-v1 subsystem. Determines whether PR #1 contains the entire supervisor-v1 runtime and identifies which broader autonomous-development components remain in AED as documented retained AED-specific integrations.

pr_scope_decision.rationale: PR #1 contains a self-contained supervisor-v1 subsystem (autocoder_supervisor Python package with five source modules: __init__.py, config.py, contracts.py, supervisor.py, validate.py). All Python imports inside the package resolve to Python stdlib + the package's own .config / .contracts relative imports. Subprocess invocations reach only 'git', 'gh', 'which', and the configured 'hermes' binary; no subprocess call references the AED repository layout. The installed wheel at /tmp/wheels/autocoder_supervisor-1.0.0-py3-none-any.whl (sha256=b32812f8b96a937d1cb7c8a432dfb97f9fd9434d1a8710000b9f06d517f50cf8) installs cleanly into a fresh venv with no AED checkout on PYTHONPATH, and all public modules (autocoder_supervisor, .supervisor, .validate, .config, .contracts) import successfully. The supervisor's CLI entry points (python -m autocoder_supervisor.supervisor --help and python -m autocoder_supervisor.validate --help) both exit 0 from the clean venv. The AED-side lifecycle subsystem (aed_lifecycle/*, aed_policy/*), the AED-side shared helpers (scripts/local/_shared_*, _ledger_review_shared.py, _smoke_shared.py, _production_facade.py), and the AED-side operation scripts (scripts/local/aed_*, scripts/local/autocoder_run_controller, scripts/local/phase_exec, scripts/local/phase_ledger, scripts/local/mutation_policy, etc.) are NOT supervisor-v1 runtime dependencies and are retained in AED as documented in docs/AED_INTEGRATION.md. Future AutoDev work may extract individual AED scripts into separate AutoDev PRs.
